To summarize, the key findings of our research, stated in one sentence that includes all relevant information, are that
the implementation of Internet marketing channels is driven by different factors depending on the dimension of the Internet marketing channels and the implementation phase of the channel.
the importance of different factors in the implementation process differs depending on the dimension of Internet-based marketing channel being implemented and the stage of the implementation process.
the implementation of Internet marketing channels is a process that is driven by different factors and that the importance of these factors may differ between the different stages of implementation.
In summary, our research is concerned with
how firms implement the Internet as a new marketing channel.
understanding the implementation process of Internet-based marketing channel.
the process of implementation of Internet-based channels and the factors influencing the implementation of these channels.
In summary, a comprehensive and detailed conclusive statement would be that
the implementation of the different Internet-based marketing channels is affected by different organizational and environmental factors.
the implementation of Internet marketing channels is a complex process, which is affected by a large number of different factors, both organizational and environmental.
the implementation of Internet based marketing channels is affected by a variety of factors and that these factors may be of different importance in the different stages of implementation.
A comprehensive summary for our work would be that

firms that have the most to gain from the use of Internet marketing channels, such as the possibility to reach new markets, have to be more willing to invest in the implementation of Internet marketing channels than firms that have less to gain.
the factors affecting the decision to use the Internet are not the same as the factors affecting the actual implementation of the Internet.

the implementation of Internet based marketing channels is not just a question of the Internet, but rather a question of organizational factors, the firm’s market environment, and the stage of the implementation process.
The main takeaway from our work is that

there is not a one size fits all implementation strategy, but that the importance of different factors depends on the specific dimension of Internet-based marketing channel that the firm wants to implement.
the factors driving the implementation process differ depending on the dimension of the Internet-based marketing channel that is being implemented.
the factors affecting the adoption of Internet-based marketing channel differ between the dimensions of the channel.
